model: RatioXGB (reg:tweedie on future/scale), prediction = multiplier x max(Monetary, 50), clipped at 0
window: 12 months of features before the cutoff, 6 months of target after it
target: net money kept in the 6 months after the cutoff, floored at 0 (returns netted off, dated at cancellation)

feature_definitions.Recency: days from last purchase to cutoff
feature_definitions.Monetary: net spend (purchases minus returns) in the feature window
feature_definitions.IPI: mean days between purchase days; blank (NaN) if one purchase day
feature_definitions.OverdueRatio: Recency / max(IPI, 1); blank if IPI blank

segments.high_value: predicted spend >= 721 GBP (80th pct of train out-of-fold predictions)
